description: This file contains functions for parsing the /proc filesystem to retrieve process information on Linux, such as parent process IDs and process names, and reconciling process ancestry in tracing contexts.

methods.name: int parse_proc_stat(struct strbuf * sb,struct strbuf * name,int * statppid)
methods.description: Parses the /proc/[pid]/stat contents to extract the process name and parent PID.

methods.name: int stat_parent_pid(pid_t pid,struct strbuf * name,int * statppid)
methods.description: Reads the /proc/[pid]/stat file and calls parse_proc_stat to obtain parent process info.

methods.name: void push_ancestry_name(struct strvec * names,pid_t pid)
methods.description: Recursively collects process names up the process hierarchy based on parent PIDs.

methods.name: void trace2_collect_process_info(enum trace2_process_info_reason reason)
methods.description: Main function that collects process ancestry information at startup or exit based on the given reason.

ctags.name: stat_parent_pid
ctags.pattern: /^static int stat_parent_pid(pid_t pid, struct strbuf *name, int *statppid)$/
